services.name: Miami sunsets
services.desc: When people think of dazzling Skyline Cruises, NY often comes to mind. But here’s the truth: Miami’s skyline is a true contender, blending tropical beauty with modern architectural marvels. It’s a vibrant display of glittering skyscrapers, serene waters, and luxurious estates, making it one of the most captivating skylines in the world. And there’s only one way to truly experience it: on Skyline Cruises. Picture yourself gliding along Biscayne Bay, with Miami’s iconic skyline as your backdrop. From the shimmering towers of Downtown Miami to the famous celebrity homes on Star Island, a Skyline Cruise offers a front-row seat to the city’s most breathtaking sights. services.name: Miami Jet Ski Tours
services.desc: Miami Guided Jet Ski Tours offer one of the most exciting ways to experience Biscayne Bay, combining high-speed riding with a structured, professionally guided route through the waters of Downtown Miami. Departing directly from Bayside Marketplace, these tours provide a unique alternative to traditional jet ski rentals in Miami by focusing on safety, direction, and a complete on-the-water experience. For the first time, this experience is being introduced in a fully organized format through Miami Skyline Cruises, bringing guided jet ski tours to the same central location already known for sightseeing on Biscayne Bay. services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Wildlife sightings are possible during your Biscayne Bay sunset tour, including dolphins, pelicans, manatees, stingrays, and jumping fish. While sightings cannot be guaranteed, marine life is commonly seen throughout Biscayne Bay during sunset

includes: Views of celebrity mansions on Star Island, Palm Island, Hibiscus Island, and Fisher Island
Seating in both indoor and outdoor areas
blurb: Guests take a 90-minute boat cruise departing daily from Bayside Marketplace in Downtown Miami. The cruise offers views of Miami's skyline, celebrity mansions on Star Island, Palm Island, Hibiscus Island, and Fisher Island, and includes English and Spanish commentary. Cruises run from morning to evening with multiple departure times and feature a comfortable, spacious boat.
extraNote: Full refunds up to 48 hours before departure · Free rescheduling if you miss your tour · No refunds for late arrivals or third-party Mojito Bar purchases · Bayside Marketplace, 401 Biscayne Blvd, Downtown Miami, check in at the window marked for boarding passes
